CustomField.formula:
SUBSTITUTE(
IF(INCLUDES( Account.Days_of_Week_Preferred__c , "Monday"), "Monday ", NULL) + IF(INCLUDES( Account.Days_of_Week_Preferred__c , "Tuesday"), "Tuesday ", NULL) + IF(INCLUDES( Account.Days_of_Week_Preferred__c , "Wednesday"), "Wednesday ", NULL) + IF(INCLUDES( Account.Days_of_Week_Preferred__c , "Thursday"), "Thursday ", NULL) + IF(INCLUDES( Account.Days_of_Week_Preferred__c , "Friday"), "Friday ", NULL) + IF(INCLUDES( Account.Days_of_Week_Preferred__c , "Saturday"), "Saturday ", NULL) + IF(INCLUDES( Account.Days_of_Week_Preferred__c , "Sunday"), "Sunday ", NULL),
";.",
NULL )
CustomField.label: Days of Week Preferred
